subject: Critical Thinking
title: Mary Wollstonecraft: Reasoning for Rights
description: Learn Mary Wollstonecraft: Reasoning for Rights in one minute.

hook.text: In 1792, Enlightenment thinkers proclaimed universal rights – for men.

buildup.text: Mary Wollstonecraft sets up the core claim, the assumptions, and the stakes.

discovery.text: Her method: turn the Enlightenment's own logic against its blind spots.

twist.text: Mary Wollstonecraft has a twist: the obvious interpretation usually breaks down.

climax.text: Mary Wollstonecraft matters because clearer reasoning leads to better judgments.

punchline.text: Mary Wollstonecraft: the goal is not certainty, but sharper thinking.

quiz.question: What was Wollstonecraft's key argumentative method?
options: Applying Enlightenment reasoning consistently to expose its own contradictions about women
